description: This file contains helper functions for Redux actions in the Mattermost project, including error handling, dispatching actions, client function binding, debounce implementation, and a custom error class.

classes.name: FormattedError
classes.description: Custom error class that includes internationalization info (id, defaultMessage, values).

methods.name: forceLogoutIfNecessary
methods.description: Checks server error and logs out user if unauthorized.

methods.name: requestData
methods.description: Creates a request action with specified type and null data.

methods.name: requestSuccess
methods.description: Creates a success action with specified type and data.

methods.name: requestFailure
methods.description: Creates a failure action with specified type and error.

methods.name: bindClientFunc
methods.description: Returns an async function that calls a client function, dispatches request, success, or failure actions, and handles errors including logout if necessary.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function with optional immediate execution and callback.
